text:
Omar: Quick help — I bought a local SIM in Barcelona for a week-long client trip because the Redwood corp card declined at the kiosk. Cash only vendor gave me a tiny paper receipt but I misplaced it. Cost was 30.00 EUR. Can I file for reimbursement to travel (TR-2026)? cc @Nina (manager).

Expense-bot: Hi Omar — policy note: missing receipts under "per-transaction threshold" (usually $75) can be approved with manager attestation plus any supporting proof (photo of vendor sign, itinerary, or bank txn). If over threshold, submit Lost Receipt Form. See https://redwood.finance/expenses/docs.

Omar: I have a photo of the SIM package and the kiosk vendor card that shows the price. Also a photo of my phone showing the active local number. Uploading them to Concur now and will set cost center TR-2026.

Diego: Finance here — for foreign cash purchases we need manager attestation and a brief note explaining why card couldn't be used. Also include exchange rate on the date or let us convert. Please redact any personal phone numbers from attachments.

Nina: Approved to charge TR-2026 for Omar's SIM during the Barcelona client trip. Nina: approved 2026-04-01. Omar: include "Client on-site: BCN 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-02" in the Concur comment.

Omar: Submitted expense EXP-5099 with photos and manager approval text. I removed the phone number from the photo. Any other docs needed?

Expense-bot: EXP-5099 received. Status: awaiting finance review. Note: foreign cash reimbursements processed in USD at company rate on txn date; expect minor FX rounding.

Diego: Reviewing now. Everything looks fine. Approving EXP-5099 and routing for payment. FYI we'll mark for audit-trace because of missing vendor receipt.

Omar: Thanks all — appreciate the help and fast turnaround.

Expense-bot: Payment scheduled. Please allow up to 72 hours for posting. If payment fails or additional audit info required, we'll reopen the thread.
